summary: Native work turns retain exact invocation bindings and protected redacted input and stopped-provider transcript evidence

replay.detail: Historical provider inputs and transcripts are not invented or backfilled. Immutable message and claim bindings retain their original identity on retry.

schema.detail: Adds optional invocation_id to native work receipts and system-only harness.invocation-artifact metadata. Content bytes remain outside claims.

rules.detail: Input capture requires authenticated exact agent, incarnation and receipt message binding. Work completion, failure and release end the exact turn. Transcript capture requires positive complete provider closure and verified native pi/omp session provenance.

compatibility.detail: New receipt kinds require the expanded claim registry. Unsupported provider envelopes and exact turn transcript intervals remain unknown. Existing input delivery continues when evidence capture is unavailable.

downtime.detail: No fleet operation is required by the source change.

manual.detail: Protected artifact reads are limited to the invocation agent and configured owning person; raw input is not exposed through metadata reads.

recovery.detail: Private redacted content expires independently of trace sampling after seven days. Metadata and per-reference deletion receipts remain durable; unavailable bytes do not fabricate a transcript.
